name: signin-page
title: Signin Page
description: A centered signin page with a logo, card, and a TanStack Form powered signin form.

files.content:
"use client" import type { ReactNode } from "react" import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle, } from "@/components/ui/card" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import { m } from "@/paraglide/messages.js" import { SigninForm, type SigninFormProps, } from "@/hoogin/blocks/signin-page/signin-form" export type SigninPageProps = Omit & { logo?: ReactNode title?: string subtitle?: string signUpHref?: string forgotPasswordHref?: string onSubmit: SigninFormProps["onSubmit"] className?: string } export function SigninPage({ logo, title = m.signinPage_title(), subtitle = m.signinPage_subtitle(), signUpHref = "/auth/signup", forgotPasswordHref = "/auth/forgot-password", error, onSubmit, className, }: SigninPageProps) { return (
{logo ?
{logo}
: null} {title} {subtitle ? {subtitle} : null}

{m.signinPage_noAccount()}{" "} {m.signinPage_signUp()}

{m.signinPage_forgotPassword()}

) }
